newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates' foreign trade amounted to $27.5 billion in 1995, says commerce and industry ministry.
- Tunisia launches $27 million plan to renew 24 textile factories.
- Egyptian Investment Organisation agreed on five projects worth $218 million, including a Saudi leather products plant.
